workflow_runs.display_title: feat(hooks): add `client` field to notify hook payload

head_commit.message:
feat(hooks): add `client` field to notify hook payload

The notify hook payload currently doesn't indicate which client
(CLI, VS Code extension, or macOS app) triggered the event. This
makes it impossible for notification tools to activate the correct
application on click.

Add a `client` field to both the legacy notify JSON and the modern
`HookPayload`, populated from the existing `SessionSource` on the
session. The field values are: "cli", "vscode", "exec", "mcp",
"sub-agent", "unknown".

Wire format after this change:

    {"type":"agent-turn-complete","client":"cli",...}
